coverage_notes: Completed 12 bounded targeted web searches focused on sole/last/full-service grocery loss, disaster-canceled emergency food distributions, abrupt pantry/food-bank access reductions, and immediate SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruptions. No new qualifying U.S. disruption was identified in the bounded prior-hour window. Fresh Kauaʻi recovery reporting indicated scheduled emergency food distributions and North Shore Food Pantry distribution were proceeding, so these were excluded as non-disruptions. Other returned items were stale, outside the United States, routine promotion, generic policy coverage, or otherwise non-qualifying.
